desc: Enable battery, charge state and temperatures — needed both for daily use and to know whether the machine is thermally safe under load. MEASURED ABSENCES in config-hid-type-fix: MACSMC is absent, CONFIG_MACSMC_POWER is explicitly not set, CONFIG_HWMON is not set. CONFIG_POWER_SUPPLY=y already. So there is currently no battery percentage, no charging state and no temperature reading anywhere. TASK: enable MACSMC (+ MACSMC_POWER, MACSMC_HWMON, HWMON) in the full kernel, confirm the SMC node in the J614s DT, and verify /sys/class/power_supply/* and /sys/class/hwmon/* populate. POLICY: this is READ-ONLY telemetry and stays inside the standing rules — smc_reboot and smc_rtc nvram writes are permitted, but charger and PMU-voltage writes remain FORBIDDEN, so do not enable or exercise any charge-control interface. Feeds the status bar in 166.
author: claude
note: 2026-07-27 SCOPING CORRECTED: macsmc IS in-tree (I looked for wrong filenames first). Kconfig: MFD_MACSMC + SENSORS_MACSMC_HWMON + RTC_DRV_MACSMC + GPIO_MACSMC + macsmc-reboot.c. So this is config + a DT node, NOT a driver port. The SMC RTKit node is in the ADT: 'smc' compatible iop,ascwrap-v6 at CPU-physical 0x50c600000 (mailbox) + 0x50c050000 (sram); smc-gpio0 at 0x50c824000. Template on t602x-die0.dtsi smc@2a2400000 (compatible apple,t6040-smc/apple,t8103-smc/apple,smc, reg-names smc/sram, mboxes=<&smc_mbox>, children gpio/hwmon/reboot/rtc), substituting the t6040 addresses. Enable MFD_MACSMC + SENSORS_MACSMC_HWMON (+HWMON) + RTC_DRV_MACSMC; POWER_SUPPLY is already y but confirm the macsmc battery/power-supply child exists. READ-ONLY telemetry only — smc_reboot/smc_rtc are the permitted writes; charger/PMU-voltage stay forbidden. Offline-buildable. NOTE t6040 smc (0x50c600000) differs from t6030's smc@36c400000 — a real per-SoC difference, addresses ADT-verified via the +0x200000000 rule confirmed on 4 nodes.
